segments.name: Consumer Products
segments.description: Sells finished dietary supplements containing proprietary Niagen® ingredients under the Tru Niagen® brand directly to consumers and through distributors.
segments.evidence: Through our consumer products segment, we provide finished dietary supplement products containing our proprietary ingredients, marketed under the Tru Niagen® brand, through direct-to-consumer channels and distributors.

segments.name: Ingredients
segments.evidence: Through our Ingredients segment, we develop and commercialize proprietary ingredient technologies, including food-grade Niagen® and pharmaceutical-grade Niagen®.

segments.name: Analytical Reference Standards and Services
segments.description: Provides research and quality-control products and services to dietary supplement, food, cosmetic, pharmaceutical and life sciences industries.
segments.evidence: Since 1999, we have provided research and quality-control products and services through our analytical reference standards and services segment.

segments.name: Pharmaceutical
segments.description: Pursues pharmaceutical development of NAD+ precursors for potential therapeutic applications in advanced aging rare diseases; no revenue yet.
segments.evidence: We are pursuing pharmaceutical development of NAD+ precursors for potential therapeutic applications in advanced aging rare diseases.

changes.text: In 2026, the company agreed to sell its analytical reference standards and services segment.
changes.evidence: On February 24, 2026, we entered into an agreement to sell our analytical reference standards and services segment.

changes.text: In 2025, the company changed its name from ChromaDex Corporation to Niagen Bioscience, Inc.
changes.evidence: Effective March 19, 2025, the Company changed its name to "Niagen Bioscience, Inc.".
